Privacy summary of FortiSafe Antivirus (Tascom Global Network LLC):

• Scanning happens on this device. None of your files is sent anywhere, not even when there is a match.

• The list of installed apps is only read after your consent, and only on this device.

• The app only connects to the internet to download the signature databases, over HTTPS. As with any connection, the server sees the device IP address.

• The VirusTotal lookup only happens if you tap it on a detection and confirm: your browser opens the site with the file's code (hash).

• No ads, no usage analytics and no crash reports.

• Nothing from the app goes to cloud backup.

Privacy contact: privacy@fortisafe.net. The full policy will be published at fortisafe.net.

What the app does
• Compares installed apps and the files on your device with signatures of known malware.
• Works offline once the signature database is downloaded.
• Alerts you when something matches, shows the evidence and leaves the decision to you.

What the app does not do
• It does not look at the content of your messages, photos or passwords: for each file it only computes a fingerprint (hash), here on the device.
• It does not filter websites or links.
• It does not analyze app behavior.

FortiSafe Antivirus accesses the list of apps installed on this device to scan each app's files for malware: when you run a scan and, if real-time protection is on, in the background whenever an app is installed or updated.

The list is processed on this device and is not sent to FortiSafe or to anyone else.

If you choose “Not now”, you can still scan files and check APKs you share with the app, and you can agree later. You can withdraw consent in Settings.

To scan downloads, downloaded APKs and the other files on your device, Android requires access to all files.

Everything happens on this device: no file is sent. For each file, the app only computes a fingerprint (hash) and compares it with the database.

The next screen belongs to Android: turn on the option for FortiSafe Antivirus and come back. You can undo this at any time in Android settings.

The app notifies you when something matches the signature database. No ads and no end-of-scan notices.

If you do not allow notifications, protection keeps working and risks show up here in the app.

The app compares your apps and files with a database of known malware signatures.
